name: resource-queue-cleanup
goal: Admit managed work without losing CPU and memory reserves, one-worker tests or current provider behavior

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Admit managed work with bounded shared reservations while preserving process ownership, output and completion.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing process matrices missed a delayed synchronous tracking callback. Retain earlier worker-ceiling and stdin proof and extend the evaluator lifecycle case.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Accepted immutable failing checkpoint 844e0f1d2c08c063a4c555b9f316e81e4c9d8510; tests were committed before product repair.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Register completion and output listeners before resource tracking can synchronously delay a fast process.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Accepted unchanged-test passing checkpoint 43dacd3706aa93cc8cda40db9d6a802fde185562 with its retained paired red record.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Frozen evaluator proof passes; earlier worker and stdin proof remains retained. Focused queue, packed API and native provider matrices pass. Global checks remain separate.
